semantics: Each JSONL file stores sparse per-round repair records. Start from shared_input[*].input_text and apply records in ascending round order by integer index. Samples absent from a round keep their previous text.

xqdt.notes: raw_model_output is retained because it is the exact JSON-form repair response.

factspotter.notes: This D2T repair baseline uses the newer DeBERTaV3-Base release. The legacy correlation baselines elsewhere in the repository use the original ELECTRA-small FactSpotter checkpoint. raw_model_output was byte-identical to repaired_text in every released D2T repair record and is omitted here.

nli.notes: The WebNLG template file is byte-identical to the Dušek-style NLI baseline template bundled under correlations/4L-RP-Human. raw_model_output was byte-identical to repaired_text in every released D2T repair record and is omitted here.

self_refine.notes: self_refine_output retains the complete model-produced critique plus revised text. The same prompt, temperature=0.7, and seed=42 were used across all nine repair generators.
